definitions.full: H1863. dardar דַּרְדַּר noun [masculine] thistles (collective) (Arabic , still current in Palestine, Löw p. 100 ; Ethiopic ) וְדַרְדַּר קוֺץ Gen 3:18 (J) Hosea 10:8 symbol of wildness, desert.
